To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ISP awareness is positively affected by ISP quality, selfefficacy, and technology awareness.
ISP quality, security awareness, and self-efficacy are significant antecedents of information security policy (ISP) awareness.

ISP quality, technology security awareness, and self-efficacy are significant antecedents of information system security awareness, which in turn significantly impact satisfaction with ISP and with security practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the factors that impact ISP awareness and its effect on satisfaction with ISP and information security practices in organizations.
understanding the role of ISP awareness in enhancing the satisfaction with information systems and security practices in the workplace.
understanding the role of ISP quality, self- efficacy, and technology security in the development of ISP awareness.

the findings of this study provide a better understanding of how ISP quality and self-efficacy affect ISP awareness.
ISP quality, security awareness, and self-efficacy have a significant impact on ISP awareness and ISP awareness significantly impacts ISP and security practice satisfaction.
ISP awareness is an important antecedent to ISP satisfaction.

the current study presents significant contribution toward understanding the antecdents of ISP awareness, and provides a starting toward including satisfaction in information security behavioral domains.
